title: CHICKEN MEAT
steps: Finely chop tarragon, zest a lemon. Separate an egg yolk.
Mix chicken mince, herbs, yolk, ricotta, breadcrumbs, zest, salt and pepper.
Roll the mixture into little balls.
Fry the meatballs in batches until browned all over. Set them aside.
Chop a leek and a bulb of fennel. Peel ten cloves of garlic.
Heat a little oil in a lidded pot. Add the leek, fennel and garlic.
Fry gently until softened. Dice two carrots and the same of celery.
Add the carrots and celery to the pot. Fry gently for a minute.
Pour in two litres of chicken stock. Bring it up to the boil.
Simmer for five minutes, then add a cup of orzo or broken spaghetti.
Simmer until the pasta is al dente. Add the meatballs to the soup.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon juice and some chopped herbs.
